'''KD-121''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] who served as a [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I heard that you found a contingent of Imperial Stormtroopers in the original research center. This is going to be great for recruitment!|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Liam Waurie]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LLW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=conversation|Lieutenant Liam Waurie|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] KD-121 was stationed at the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], along with fellow stromtroopers [[GT-643]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS" />

[[File:Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Camp Epsilon]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> KD-121, GT-643, and HX-138 were part of<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> a contingent of stormtroopers who appeared to be immunized to the virus.<ref name="SWG:StT" /> They survived the outbreak but were trapped in the Quarantine Zone like other survivors. The stormtroopers and the other refugees created a makeshift camp, designated as [[Camp Epsilon]], in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> Those other survivors included the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]]<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref>, the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]].<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> In fact, Camp Epsilon was very unsafe since it was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, the place where lived the most dangerous undeads.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> However, the camp was established around a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], the last [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the area that was not destroyed during the outbreak. The ship was damaged and unable to fly but Nils Cridmeen and the stormtroopers expected to fix it in order to allow the survivors to escape the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:SP" />

A group of spacers visited Camp Epsilon during their journey in the Quarantine Zone. They assisted the stormtroopers in rescuing some survivors<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> and finding parts to fix the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The spacers later left Camp Epsilon to enter the Imperial Research and Prison Facility in order to recover a sample of the Blackwing virus.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> The spacers survived to their mission and finally came back to Camp Epsilon. In the meantime, Nils Cridmeen was able to fix the Lambda-class shuttle. The refugees of Camp Epsilon and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the repaired shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
KD-121 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> KD-121 was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
